description: Proposes a correction to an EXISTING ledger booking: wrong cost center, wrong account, wrong amount or wrong month. This does NOT change the original booking and does NOT post to the ledger: it creates a PENDING proposal that a human approves in the web app. On approval a reversal of the original booking plus a corrected re-booking are written. The transaction id is the `id` of a row from `search_cost_center_transactions`. A booking that does not exist yet is proposed with `propose-manual-adjustment`.

new_account.description: New account — only if the account or its sub-account changes. Notation "4321" or "8400/130". Without a sub-account it is resolved automatically when the account has exactly one variant (the old sub-account is never carried over); if there are several, pass the full account/sub-account.

new_amount.description: New amount, in the same sign convention as the original booking (positive = expense/revenue on that account) — only if the amount changes; 0 means the booking was a duplicate and is only reversed

new_cost_center.description: New cost center / Kostenstelle — only if the cost center changes

new_period.description: New accounting month (YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD) — only if the month changes

organization_id.description: ID of the organization this call runs in (from list_organizations). Required for tools that change data when you belong to more than one organization. Read tools use the active organization when omitted. Does not change the active organization.

reason.description: Why the booking is corrected; mandatory for the audit trail

transaction_id.description: UUID of the existing booking, from `search_cost_center_transactions`

name: propose-transaction-correction
